name: Takayama Ayame
source:
Ayame is an old classmate of [url=/c702]Harunobu[/url]. Unable to cope with the trauma of her parent’s divorce and remarriages, Ayame dropped out of school to find refuge with a violent street gang. She had always been envious of the familial harmony Harunobu enjoyed, and became sadden by the tragedy they suffered.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
